legal.title: End User License Agreement
legal.agreementBody: By downloading or using Georgia Safe, you agree to Apple's Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement, which is incorporated into these terms, and to the additional Georgia Safe terms below.
legal.servicesBody: Georgia Safe provides travel-safety information, maps, reference phone numbers and user-initiated communication tools. It is an informational aid and communication shortcut.
legal.emergencyBody: Georgia Safe is not an emergency service, monitoring service or dispatch centre. The Call 112 button only opens a telephone call on your device. The app does not send your identity or location to 112, does not contact emergency services in the background and cannot guarantee that a call connects or help arrives. In an emergency, contact 112 directly and follow official instructions.
legal.smsBody: The trusted-contact action opens your device's Messages composer with the phone number you entered and prepared text. When location permission is granted and a position is available, the text may include a map link. You must review the recipient and message and tap Send yourself. Georgia Safe cannot verify delivery, receipt, reading or a response.
legal.locationBody: With your permission, location is used for map context, nearby safety information, optional landmark-arrival alerts and a map link in a trusted-contact SMS. Location may be delayed, inaccurate or unavailable. Georgia Safe does not send your location to 112 or nearby Georgia Safe users.
legal.reliabilityTitle: Do not rely on the app alone
legal.reliabilityBody: Features can be unavailable because of device settings, permissions, network or cellular coverage, third-party services or operating-system limits. Safety information may change. Do not rely on Georgia Safe as your only way to request help or make urgent safety decisions.
legal.privacyBody: Use of personal data and location is described in the Privacy Policy. You control system permissions and can revoke location access in device settings.
legal.acceptance: If you do not agree to these terms, do not use Georgia Safe.
